10f0e7fb-e12d-4c7c-ae62-27ddff3dc9bd/Eve.en: Raising a Jiao is like nurturing a child.<NL>Those who wish for it to become a Loong soon raise it with an anxious heart;<NL>those who follow the development of nature raise it with equanimity;<NL>those who regulate its behavior raise it with caution and care.<NL>These three methods of nurturing all have their advantages and disadvantages, truths and mysteries.<NL>How to choose among them lies entirely within a single thought of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>...

f6318cf7-24bd-4099-989c-b82c71700f1f/Eve.en: Water striking against rocks produces a sound, challenging one's aspirations to lead to greatness.<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> sees that <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> has been mild and tame recently.<NL>It seems that employing the method of aggressively pushing forward its development through nurturing <color=#orange>may yield unexpectedly remarkable results</color>...

ebd97172-e2f5-4ed6-835e-f65711a20768/Eve.en: After a moment of contemplation,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> requests the villagers to bring a hundred carp and release them into the Jiao Pool.<NL>As the fish enter the pond, they immediately gather around <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>, frolicking near the Jiao's tail or swimming around the rocks.<NL>As expected, this indeed prompts <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> to sway its tail energetically, riding the waves and soaring into the sky...<NL><NL><color=#yellow>(<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s <ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>!)</color>

037ac24e-37d0-49db-96d7-03264cf97745/Eve.en: After a moment of contemplation,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> requests the villagers to construct Loong boats and place them in the Jiao Pool.<NL>Then, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> calls upon tens of people to board the Jiao boats, taking turns rowing and paddling, breaking through the waves with speed.<NL>As expected, this enticed <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> to leap into the water, joining in the race, and playing joyfully for quite some time...<NL><NL><color=#yellow>(<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s <ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>!)</color>

6e166020-a109-42b3-b2d0-ed4df7112ea2/Eve.en: After a moment of contemplation,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> requests the villagers to bring a hundred snakes and pheasants, placing them around the Jiao Pool.<NL>As expected, this causes <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> to soar into the sky, engaging in a fierce battle with the mini Loong and fenghuang...<NL>After a short while, <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> successfully captures the Loong and Fenghuang alive...<NL><NL><color=#yellow>(<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s <ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>!)</color>

ba5d2b0c-94d7-4bf6-8497-12e0c688f55d/Eve.en: After a moment of contemplation, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> summons tens of villagers<NL>and requests them to either hold gongs or set up drums in a line along the edge of the Jiao Pool.<NL>After a signal from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, they begin to beat the gongs and drums vigorously, creating a resounding wall of sound.<NL>After a while, <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> gracefully soars into the clouds, stirring up a mighty wind; it sucks up the water in the pool and spews forth torrential rain...<NL><NL><color=#yellow>(<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s <ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>!)</color>

d817a38a-f7ab-481f-aa60-4f0c976a3c51/Eve.en: After a moment of contemplation, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> fetches ink, a caligraphy brush, paper, and an inkstone,<NL>and begins to draw pavilions, flowers, birds, and all manner of worldly phenomena right before <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s eyes.<NL>After a while, as expected, <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>spouts clouds and mist, which forms mirages above the vast Jiao Pool.<NL>At times, one can see magnificent palaces and celestial maidens, while at other times, azure mountains and flying birds and beasts appear, intertwining with one another...<NL><NL><color=#yellow>(<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s <ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>!)</color>
